title: Brainrot Puzzle
release_date: 2025-05 (Poki, browser – desktop and mobile web) [CONFIRMED – Poki game page lists May 2025 release]; latest update June 2026 per Poki DE page
window_note: in window (May 2025); rode the May 2025 'Italian brainrot' meme wave (Tralalero Tralala, Ballerina Cappuccina, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Bombardiro Crocodilo)
developer: Playrea (Artem Lanin – Medium byline on the @playrea account; itch.io: playrea_official, site playrea.com)
team_size: 1 (solo developer) [CONFIRMED – developer's own Medium post written in first person]
developer_background: Hobbyist since 2020; submitted 25+ games to Google Play/App Store with no visibility; many small browser games on itch.io (Chicken Fighters, Sweet Risk, Deep in the Folders, Pocket Universe, Ants Defenders, Pirate's Dice, Tricky Maze, etc.). Moved to Poki in 2025: Pocket Zoo (passed Poki's Web Fit Test but did not take off), Guess the Emojis (improved via Poki Playtests and did much better), Brainrot Puzzle (breakout), then Brainrot Merge (Oct 2025, tile-match) and Pizza Day (Dec 2025, pizza-kitchen sim). Now full-time with Poki as main income [CONFIRMED – dev's Medium post, 2025-12-29].
publisher: Poki (web portal / distribution partner); developer-owned game
platforms_and_store_links: Poki: https://poki.com/en/g/brainrot-puzzle ; dev itch.io: https://playrea-official.itch.io ; sister titles: https://poki.com/en/g/brainrot-merge , https://poki.com/en/g/pizza-day
business_model: Free-to-play browser game monetized by Poki ads (pre-roll/midroll/rewarded via Poki SDK); revenue share – 50/50 on Poki-sourced traffic, 100% to dev on direct traffic (per Poki SDK terms as summarized by third-party guides)
units_or_downloads: Brainrot Puzzle: 1M gameplays in a single day at peak (May 2025) [CONFIRMED – developer's Medium post]; per-game lifetime total not disclosed. Developer portfolio (5 Poki games): 67M gameplays in 2025 and ~200k gameplays/day around year-end [CONFIRMED – developer's Medium post, 2025-12-29]. Brainrot Puzzle likely the largest share: ~25–45M gameplays in 2025 [ESTIMATE – assumes 40–65% of the 67M given its 1M/day peak and being the top hit; no per-game split published]. Poki rating 4.5 from ~134.8k votes (2026) [CONFIRMED – Poki DE page via search snippet].
peak_concurrent_players: ~17,000 concurrent players at peak (May 2025) [CONFIRMED – developer's Medium post]
implied_review_multiplier: n/a (browser). For reference: ~25–45M estimated gameplays ÷ ~134.8k Poki votes ≈ 190–330 gameplays per vote [ESTIMATE]
gross_revenue: no disclosed figure. Portfolio 2025 ad revenue (gross, before Poki split) ≈ $130k–$530k [ESTIMATE – 67M gameplays × $2–$8 per 1,000 gameplays; web portal ads, young/global meme audience lowers CPMs]. Brainrot Puzzle share ≈ $50k–$360k [ESTIMATE – 25–45M gameplays × same rate]. Context: Poki says its top developers earn ~$50k–$1M per year (Poki press release); third-party guides put a typical first Poki game at $500–$3,000/month.
net_revenue: Developer share ≈ 50% of Poki-sourced revenue (assumed nearly all traffic is Poki-sourced): Brainrot Puzzle ≈ $25k–$180k; whole 2025 portfolio ≈ $65k–$265k [ESTIMATE – 50/50 split, no store cut; ×0.93 for invalid traffic omitted because portal reports are already net]. Developer states Poki is now his main income source (consistent with this range).
production_cost: no disclosed figure. Solo, est. 2–6 weeks × ~$3k–$6k/month ≈ $1.5k–$9k opportunity cost (developer's own unpaid time; country unknown) [ESTIMATE]; tooling costs negligible.
development_time: no data; a simple swap-puzzle with meme images is likely 2–6 weeks for an experienced web dev [ESTIMATE]. Shipped while the meme was peaking in May 2025, so speed was key.
why_popular: Perfect trend timing: launched during the May 2025 peak of the Italian brainrot meme (kids/teens on TikTok/YouTube Shorts). Ultra-simple, mobile-friendly mechanic (drag a piece onto another to swap) that 'unlocks' a collection of the meme characters – collection + recognition + instant play with no install. Poki's front-page/category exposure (a dedicated Brainrot games category) amplified search traffic for 'brainrot games'.
marketing_channels: Poki platform discovery (homepage/category featuring, search) riding external meme demand from TikTok/YouTube Shorts; Poki Playtests used to iterate on earlier games; no paid UA reported. School/unblocked-games traffic typical of Poki audiences.
engine: no data (not disclosed in any source found; Poki supports Unity WebGL, Defold, Construct, Phaser, PlayCanvas, Godot). A different 'Italian Brainrot Merge' on CrazyGames lists Unity 6, but it is not confirmed to be Playrea's.
art_style: Bright 2D meme imagery (AI-generated-style Italian brainrot characters) cut into puzzle tiles; minimal UI
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: write the entire tile-swap/merge logic, progression and Poki SDK integration in days; generate character art and backgrounds (the meme itself is AI-image-native), SFX and music. | AI cannot: spot and ship on a trend within days of its peak, get portal featuring, or guarantee the IP/likeness situation (meme characters are community-made, but using specific creators' art can be an issue); also cannot replace playtesting the first-minute experience (the dev credits Poki Playtests). | Toolset: Claude Code + Phaser 3 / Construct 3 / Defold (or Unity WebGL), Poki SDK, Midjourney/Retro Diffusion/Scenario for 2D art, ElevenLabs SFX, Suno music.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: 3–10 days, $30–$150 (Claude Pro, image-gen sub; Poki submission is free; excludes living costs)
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: 3–6 weeks, $150–$600 (more levels/characters, localization, rewarded-ad hooks, playtest iterations)

data_conflicts: 1) The 67M gameplays figure covers all 5 Poki games in 2025, not Brainrot Puzzle alone; the per-game split is not published – Brainrot Puzzle total is an estimate. 2) Poki vote counts vary slightly across locales (~134.5k–134.8k) because snapshots differ. 3) Revenue: no disclosed figure; per-1,000-gameplay rates for Poki are not public, so a wide range is given. 4) Identity: the 'Playrea' handle and the Medium byline Artem Lanin are assumed to be the same person; the itch.io page says 'Making mobile games!'.
notes: Strong template for a solo + AI creator: (1) watch TikTok/Shorts meme trends, (2) ship a dead-simple, instantly understood web game within days, (3) put it on Poki/CrazyGames where kids already search for the trend, (4) follow up with sister games (Brainrot Merge) to keep the traffic (~200k plays/day across the portfolio). Trend games decay fast, so a portfolio approach matters. Poki's Web Fit Test and Playtests tools were key to the developer's learning curve.
